Basal anchoring interpretation and pustules-as-zooids uncertain; no feeding tentacles invented.

concept_decisions: Actual concept has correct connected narrow lamina and short blunt base, but is overly symmetrical and overregular. Retain continuous full-volume frond, subtly unequal lateral structures and low relief on both broad surfaces, sparse haphazard pustules on front only. Eighteen oblique structures each side as approximate about-three-dozen layout, not fossil-count assertion. No open negative spaces between structures: connected common sheet. Short basal attachment remains partly frond-like and blunt, not a big modern sea-pen bulb or plant roots. Rear has angled relief but no pustules. Thin solid cross-section, gentle bent pose, no rock slab or environment base.
